title: needs-decision: investigate idd-advisory-convergence rollup staleness after pull_request_review events
body:
<!-- idd-skill-authoring-publication: target=target-a2f65c80a9c763ea; anchor=kurone-kito/idd-skill#2843; set=set-0a071ee0641b88b6; session=claude-sonnet5-95c4e29c82659dc7; token=pub-9fe62b3073dcda05 -->

## Background

A field-feedback gist reported that, across 3 independent merged PRs in
one adopter session (all on `idd-skill` `v0.9.0`, tagged
2026-09-06T22:36:44+09:00), the `idd-advisory-convergence` required-check
rollup repeatedly failed to reflect its own latest completed run after a
review event, needing several `gh run rerun` / `idd-rerun-
advisory-convergence --apply` recoveries before the merge gate cleared.
Concrete API-verified evidence from one PR
(`kurone-kito/dotfiles#398`, single unchanged head commit `0f06b2a`): 9
`idd-advisory-convergence` check-run instances within a 14-minute window
(8 `success` + 1 `cancelled`), each completing successfully on its own,
with the rollup not settling to a clean required-check state until the
final rerun.

This is **not** a "predates the fix" case: `idd-skill` `v0.9.0` already
includes every closed fix previously filed against this same symptom
area, all closed before the `v0.9.0` tag date --
`#2638` (closed 2026-09-05), `#2643` (closed 2026-09-05), `#2136` (closed
2026-08-18), and `#2326` (closed 2026-09-01) -- and the adopter still hit
the symptom on top of all of them.

Directly checked `.github/workflows/idd-advisory-convergence.yml` at
current `main`: its trigger config is `pull_request:
[opened, reopened, synchronize]` + `pull_request_review: [submitted]` +
`workflow_dispatch`. Every review submission (a CodeRabbit re-review, a
Copilot re-review, a disposition-triggering review event) independently
re-triggers a fresh run of this workflow -- confirming, as verified fact
rather than the adopter's own unconfirmed theory, that a
`pull_request_review`-triggered check-run cascade is a real, live trigger
surface for repeated reruns in a short window.

`kurone-kito/idd-skill#1745` ("CI-rollup divergence + over-broad
bot-gated-skip caused a false CODEOWNER-deadlock diagnosis") closed
2026-08-01, well before all of the above.

## Proposed change

This needs a maintainer decision/investigation because it is unclear
which of the following applies:

1. This is a distinct rerun-cascade code path from `#1745`/`#2638`/
   `#2643`/`#2136`/`#2326` that has not yet been isolated -- reproduce
   with a PR that receives review-dispositioning comments after CI/check
   completion, and check whether the required-check rollup evaluation
   reads a stale check-run id captured before the review event, rather
   than re-resolving the latest run for the same
   `(checkName, workflowName, headSha)` key.
2. This is a genuine regression in one of those closed fixes' coverage,
   specifically for the `pull_request_review`-triggered case.
3. This is working as designed, with existing (but not automatic)
   recovery tooling: the adopter's PR did eventually merge using the
   existing `idd-rerun-advisory-convergence --apply` helper, so this may
   reduce to a scope question of whether that recovery should trigger
   automatically instead of needing a manual/agent-invoked rerun.

Confidence on this finding is lower than the other tracks in this
roadmap -- it comes from a single adopter, though with solid,
API-verified evidence (the 9-check-run/14-minute data point above) -- so
route it to investigation and an explicit maintainer disposition rather
than a presumed fix.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A maintainer or investigating session reproduces (or fails to
      reproduce) the rollup-staleness symptom against a PR that receives
      review-dispositioning comments after CI/check completion, using the
      trigger surface confirmed above.
- [ ] The investigation records which of the three directions above
      applies, or an alternative disposition, as a comment or an update
      to this issue.
- [ ] If a code fix is warranted, this issue (or a follow-up issue it
      spawns) is re-authored with concrete acceptance criteria matching
      the chosen direction and routed back into the normal `ready`
      execution flow.

## Candidate files

- `.github/workflows/idd-advisory-convergence.yml`
- `idd-template/.github/workflows/idd-advisory-convergence.yml`
- `scripts/rerun-advisory-convergence.mjs`
